entry.name: locationName
entry.label: Empty until the user picks a place; the widget asks for one while it is.

entry.name: region
entry.label: First-level administrative area of the place (the county, in Romania); official warnings are issued for it.

entry.name: savedPlaces
entry.label: The other places kept, to switch to from the header: each as JSON, { name, latitude, longitude, region, countryCode }.

entry.name: showAirQuality
entry.label: Air quality and pollen, from the CAMS forecasts through Open-Meteo.

entry.name: notifyAlerts
entry.label: A desktop notification for every new official warning.

entry.name: notifyRain
entry.label: A desktop notification when rain or snow is about to start, within half an hour.

entry.name: notifyFrost
entry.label: A desktop notification in the evening when the night brings frost.

entry.name: notifyMorning
entry.label: A desktop notification in the morning, at morningTime, with a summary of the day.

entry.name: morningTime
entry.label: When the summary of the day comes, as HH:MM.

entry.name: morningParts
entry.label: What the summary leaves out: temperatures, rain, uv, alerts, pollen, yesterday; empty for all of it.

entry.name: morningTold
entry.label: The day the summary was last sent, so that a restart does not send it again.

entry.name: showNowcasting
entry.label: The immediate warnings of ANM, from its own website; nothing is asked of that website while this is off.

entry.name: language
entry.label: auto, or one of the languages of code/strings: ro, en, de, es, fr, it, pl

entry.name: firstDayOfWeek
entry.label: 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday; -1 follows the regional settings of the system.

entry.name: fontScale
entry.label: Size of the text, in percent of the font of the Plasma theme.

entry.name: fontFamily
entry.label: Empty for Inter, the font that comes with the widget.

entry.name: background
entry.label: black, theme or none (transparent)

entry.name: backgroundTransparency
entry.label: How transparent the transparent background is, in percent: 0 is the background of the Plasma theme, 100 is none at all.

entry.name: showRainInPanel
entry.label: In a panel, show beside the temperature when the next rain starts, within half a day.

entry.name: iconSet
entry.label: meteocons or breeze (the icons of the Plasma theme)

entry.name: animations
entry.label: full, reduced or off

entry.name: todayParts
entry.label: What the Today tab shows besides the weather now: clock (the time of the place, under the date), hours, conditions (wind, humidity and precipitation), insights, rain, yesterday.

entry.name: todayGlass
entry.label: How transparent the dark glass of the Today tab is, under the hours and the wind, humidity and precipitation, in percent: 0 is opaque, 100 is none at all.

entry.name: landscape
entry.label: The land drawn under the sky of the Today tab: one of KINDS in code/land.mjs, none, hills, city, sea, poppies, lake or village.

entry.name: landscapeHeight
entry.label: How much of the height of the Today tab the landscape takes, in percent.

entry.name: activities
entry.label: The activities of the Activities tile, see code/activities.mjs; empty for those of a new widget.

entry.name: detailsOrder
entry.label: The tiles of the Details tab, in the order they were dragged into; empty for the order of a new widget. See code/details.mjs.

entry.name: hiddenTiles
entry.label: The tiles of the Details tab that are turned off, by id; at least one stays.

entry.name: frostTold
entry.label: The day the frost of the night was last told, so that a restart in the evening does not tell it again.

entry.name: hiddenTabs
entry.label: Ids of the tabs that are turned off: today, hours, rain, days, details.

entry.name: precipitationUnit
entry.label: mm or inch

entry.name: windUnit
entry.label: kmh, ms, mph, or knots written kn or kt
